transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, we've got 600 drums of moisture-sensitive polyurethane adhesive on a receiving hold due to a temperature alarm, and Friday's production schedule needs adhesive from this shipment or an approved replacement. I'm the one who makes the final warehouse decision on disposition and staging, but site policy requires documented findings from Quality, Maintenance, Logistics, and EHS before I can close this hold or finalize disposition. I'd like to get all four of those functions engaged right away so we can move this forward. Can I get each of you to share what you know and what your function's findings are?

transcript.text: I completed my quality review of the temperature logger this morning. Here's what I found: exactly 72 drums exceeded the approved 8°C exposure limit for 90 minutes, and the remaining 528 drums stayed within specification. Our quality procedure permits exactly 528 drums for release and requires exactly 72 drums to remain quarantined. I have not yet entered this result in the warehouse hold record, but I'm sharing it with the group now so we can move forward.
